gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-tamil: Mystery Quest looks like an old paperback cover, curves left open at the jaws. Anek Tamil's big round sans bowls make it the pair's real charm: a modern, generous body under a nostalgic, bookish head.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads wide and tall, its rounds left unlatched like hooks. Over a full page that gives a clean, approachable sans-serif rhythm, while Mystery Quest keeps its bookish, nostalgic accent up in the heading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anuphan: Anuphan brings big round lowercase bowls and curves with clear gaps, tidy and unfussy in its sans-serif way. Mystery Quest sits over it with open-jawed, nostalgic letters, so old and new share the page.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-arimo: Mystery Quest has a bookish, nostalgic look, with open jaws on its curves and compact ascenders. Arimo follows in a plain sans with a tall mean line and spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-athiti: Athiti reads approachable and current, with see-through s shapes and a high mean line. Its joins stay as thick as its stems, which is the sharpest difference from the thin-jointed, bookish Mystery Quest above.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Atkinson Hyperlegible has clipped-looking capitals and ascenders beside its lowercase. Down a whole page that makes a approachable, steady sans texture, with Mystery Quest adding a nostalgic, bookish heading on top.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono reads approachable, its spacing stretched open like stencil bridges and its counters breathing freely. Mystery Quest, meanwhile, does its best work with bookish, open-jawed curves, while the mono body simply keeps every letter distinct.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-biryani: Bookish type up top, a crisp and friendly sans-serif below: Mystery Quest has open-jawed curves, while Biryani gives every e a large clear eye. Shrink the heading and its character fades.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-blinker: Blinker reads clean and approachable, its lowercase filling most of the height at one steady line width. Mystery Quest does the nostalgic, bookish heading work with its open-jawed curves, while Blinker simply keeps the text open and easy.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads modern and sure, with a high-set x-height and generous openings. Mystery Quest earns its keep big and short, where its open jaws and bookish, nostalgic air show off.
